scripts.name: Setup
scripts.command: (set -e; if [ -n "${T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT:-}" ]; then for file in .env .env.local apps/backend/.env apps/frontend/.env apps/frontend/.env.local; do if [ -f "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$file" ] && [ ! -e "$file" ] && [ ! -L "$file" ]; then (umask 077; cp "$T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/$file" "$file"); fi; done; fi; bun install --frozen-lockfile)

scripts.name: Archive · Build output
scripts.command: if [ -f .git ]; then git clean -fdX -- apps/backend/dist/ apps/frontend/dist/ packages/shared/dist/; fi
